description.narrative: The objective of BPPR III is to fund analytical, advisory and technical assistance work, capacity building efforts, and in some cases data collection in order to inform and improve the quality of PRSPs and poverty reduction initiatives in Sub-Saharan Africa, and to facilitate their implementation among others through the budget process. While most funds will be used to finance activities in ten priority countries of the Belgian cooperation (Benin, Burundi, Democratic Republic of Congo, Mali, Mozambique, Niger, Rwanda, Senegal, Tanzania, Uganda), a few activities will also have a sub-regional or regional scope.
